mapper.select:
select i.id, i.dept_id, i.device_id, i.name, i.device_serial, i.ip_address, i.firmware_version, i.dev_protocol_version, i.status, i.luser_id, i.create_time, i.update_time, i.remark from ehome_device i left join sys_dept d on i.dept_id=d.dept_id
and i.id=#{id}
and (i.name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or i.device_id like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or i.device_serial like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or i.ip_address like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
and i.status=#{status} and i.dev_protocol_version like concat(#{devProtocolVersion},'%')
and exists (select 1 from wvp_device_category_relation cr join wvp_device_category cc on cc.id=cr.category_id where cr.protocol_type='EHOME' and cr.device_key=cast(i.id as char) and cr.category_type=#{categoryType} and (cc.id=#{categoryId} or find_in_set(#{categoryId},cc.ancestors)))
and not exists (select 1 from wvp_device_category_relation cr where cr.protocol_type='EHOME' and cr.device_key=cast(i.id as char) and cr.category_type=#{categoryType})
${params.dataScope}
order by i.create_time desc, i.id desc
select id from ehome_device where device_id=#{deviceId} order by id limit 1
mapper.update: update ehome_device set device_serial=#{deviceSerial}, ip_address=#{ipAddress}, firmware_version=#{firmwareVersion},dev_protocol_version=#{devProtocolVersion}, luser_id=#{luserId},status='ON',update_time=now() where id=#{id}
update ehome_device set status='OFFLINE',update_time=now() where luser_id=#{luserId}
update ehome_device set status='OFFLINE' where status='ON'
